# devin_oncall_responder (Resource)

Manages a Devin Oncall responder: an auto-triage automation that watches one alert source (Slack channels or user-group mentions, Microsoft Teams channels, PagerDuty incidents, or an incoming webhook) and starts a triage session for each new alert. The triggers/tools/limits/session_settings/session groups are JSON-encoded (use jsonencode(...)); their configured values are authoritative and out-of-band edits to them are not detected as drift. The devin_oncall_schemas data source documents the supported trigger event types and condition fields.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Slack, minimal: triage every new message in one channel with the default
# runbook, running as the organization.
resource "devin_oncall_responder" "payments" {
  org_id             = devin_organization.payments.org_id
  name               = "Payments oncall"
  triage_issue_type  = "alerts"
  slack_reply_access = "slack_users"

  triggers = jsonencode([{
    event_type = "slack:message"
    conditions = {
      any = [{ all = [{ field = "channel", operator = "eq", value = "C0123ABC" }] }]
    }
  }])
}

# Slack, complete: two channels plus a user-group mention (triggers are OR'd),
# a custom runbook, tools, limits, session settings, a cost-code tag and a
# service user identity.
resource "devin_oncall_responder" "checkout" {
  org_id            = devin_organization.payments.org_id
  name              = "Checkout oncall"
  triage_issue_type = "alerts"
  runbook           = file("${path.module}/runbooks/checkout.md")

  triggers = jsonencode([
    {
      event_type = "slack:message"
      conditions = {
        any = [{ all = [
          { field = "channel", operator = "in", value = ["C0INCIDENTS", "C0CHECKOUT"] },
          { field = "is_thread_reply", operator = "eq", value = false },
        ] }]
      }
    },
    {
      event_type = "slack:usergroup_mentioned"
      conditions = {
        any = [{ all = [
          { field = "channel", operator = "eq", value = "C0CHECKOUT" },
          { field = "usergroup", operator = "eq", value = "S0ONCALL" },
        ] }]
      }
    },
  ])

  tools = jsonencode({
    mcp_servers    = ["datadog", "sentry"]
    slack_channels = [{ team_id = "T0WORKSPACE", channel_id = "C0CHECKOUT" }]
    linear_enabled = true
  })

  limits = jsonencode({
    max_acu_limit = 20
    invocations   = { max_per_window = 30, window_seconds = 3600 }
  })

  session_settings = jsonencode({ devin_mode = "fast" })
  session          = jsonencode({ tags = ["oncall-checkout"] })

  slack_reply_access     = "devin_users"
  run_as                 = "service_user"
  run_as_service_user_id = var.oncall_service_user_id
  metadata               = { team = "checkout", owner = "payments-eng" }
}

# Microsoft Teams: every condition group names the team and its channels.
resource "devin_oncall_responder" "teams_platform" {
  org_id             = devin_organization.platform.org_id
  name               = "Platform oncall (Teams)"
  triage_issue_type  = "alerts"
  teams_reply_access = "teams_users"

  triggers = jsonencode([{
    event_type = "teams:message"
    conditions = {
      any = [{ all = [
        { field = "team_id", operator = "eq", value = "00000000-aaaa-bbbb-cccc-000000000000" },
        { field = "channel_id", operator = "in", value = ["19:abc@thread.tacv2", "19:def@thread.tacv2"] },
      ] }]
    }
  }])
}

# PagerDuty: triage P1 incidents of the payments service when they trigger,
# and again when they resolve to leave a summary.
data "devin_oncall_schemas" "payments" {
  org_id = devin_organization.payments.org_id
}

resource "devin_oncall_responder" "pd_payments" {
  org_id                  = devin_organization.payments.org_id
  name                    = "Payments P1 (PagerDuty)"
  triage_issue_type       = "alerts"
  pagerduty_connection_id = data.devin_oncall_schemas.payments.pagerduty_connection_id

  triggers = jsonencode([
    {
      event_type = "pagerduty:incident_triggered"
      conditions = {
        any = [{ all = [
          { field = "incident.service", operator = "eq", value = "payments-api" },
          { field = "incident.priority", operator = "eq", value = "P1" },
        ] }]
      }
    },
    { event_type = "pagerduty:incident_resolved" },
  ])
}

# Webhook: one webhook:incoming trigger and no conditions. Alerting systems
# POST to webhook_url with webhook_secret in the X-Webhook-Secret header.
resource "devin_oncall_responder" "grafana_alerts" {
  org_id            = devin_organization.platform.org_id
  name              = "Grafana alerts"
  triage_issue_type = "alerts"
  triggers          = jsonencode([{ event_type = "webhook:incoming" }])
}

output "grafana_webhook_url" {
  value = devin_oncall_responder.grafana_alerts.webhook_url
}

output "grafana_webhook_secret" {
  value     = devin_oncall_responder.grafana_alerts.webhook_secret
  sensitive = true
}

# Many teams with for_each: one responder per team from a single map.
locals {
  oncall_teams = {
    payments = { channel = "C0PAYMENTS", service_user = "service-user-payments" }
    search   = { channel = "C0SEARCH", service_user = "service-user-search" }
    infra    = { channel = "C0INFRA", service_user = "service-user-infra" }
  }
}

resource "devin_oncall_responder" "team" {
  for_each = local.oncall_teams

  org_id             = devin_organization.main.org_id
  name               = "${each.key} oncall"
  triage_issue_type  = "alerts"
  slack_reply_access = "slack_users"

  triggers = jsonencode([{
    event_type = "slack:message"
    conditions = {
      any = [{ all = [{ field = "channel", operator = "eq", value = each.value.channel }] }]
    }
  }])

  run_as                 = "service_user"
  run_as_service_user_id = each.value.service_user
  metadata               = { team = each.key }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Responder name.
- `org_id` (String) Organization ID that owns this responder.
- `triggers` (String) JSON-encoded array of triggers (use jsonencode(...)). Each trigger has event_type ('slack:message', 'slack:usergroup_mentioned', 'teams:message', a 'pagerduty:incident_*' event, or 'webhook:incoming') and optional conditions (two-level any/all envelope of {field, operator, value}). All triggers of a responder use one provider; every Slack group needs a channel restriction; every teams:message group needs team_id eq and channel_id eq/in; webhook:incoming must be the only trigger and has no conditions; pagerduty:* triggers need pagerduty_connection_id.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the responder triages new alerts. Defaults to true.
- `limits` (String) JSON-encoded limits object (use jsonencode(...)): max_acu_limit (1-1000) and/or invocations ({max_per_window >= 1, window_seconds >= 60}).
- `metadata` (Map of String) Org-visible key/value labels. At most 16 pairs; keys at most 32 chars; values at most 128.
- `pagerduty_connection_id` (String) PagerDuty connection the pagerduty:* triggers listen on (see devin_oncall_schemas.pagerduty_connection_id).
- `run_as` (String) Identity triage sessions run under: 'organization', 'creator' or 'service_user' (the service user named by run_as_service_user_id). Unset means 'organization'.
- `run_as_service_user_id` (String) ID of the service user triage sessions run as. Required when run_as is 'service_user' and must be unset otherwise.
- `runbook` (String) Triage instructions given to every session the responder starts. Defaults to the organization's default runbook (see devin_oncall_schemas.default_runbook); omit it to use the default.
- `session` (String) JSON-encoded session object (use jsonencode(...)): tags, the session tags (cost codes) triage sessions bill to. At most 16 tags; organizations that enforce required session tags must supply exactly one allowed tag.
- `session_settings` (String) JSON-encoded settings for triage sessions (use jsonencode(...)): devin_mode (normal, fast, lite, ultra, fusion; see devin_oncall_schemas.available_devin_modes) and net_policy.
- `slack_reply_access` (String) Who may reply into triage sessions from Slack threads: 'devin_users', 'slack_users' or 'external_slack_users'. Slack responders only; the server default is 'slack_users'.
- `team_id` (String) Slack workspace (team) ID of the watched channels, for organizations with more than one connected workspace. Slack responders only.
- `teams_reply_access` (String) Who may reply into triage sessions from Microsoft Teams threads: 'devin_users' or 'teams_users'. Teams responders only; the server default is 'teams_users'.
- `tools` (String) JSON-encoded tools object (use jsonencode(...)): mcp_servers, slack_channels ([{team_id, channel_id}]), teams_channels and linear_enabled granted to triage sessions.
- `triage_issue_type` (String) What the responder triages: 'alerts' (monitoring alerts, incidents and pages) or 'bugs' (bug reports and support questions). Devin provisions a triage Board for the responder when set; omitting it creates a legacy responder without one. Changing it replaces the responder, which deletes its triage Board and the tickets on it.

### Read-Only

- `responder_id` (String) Responder ID (assigned by Devin).
- `source` (String) Alert source derived from the triggers: slack, teams, pagerduty, webhook, linear or jira.
- `source_channel_id` (String) Primary watched channel (Slack/Teams responders); empty for other sources.
- `webhook_secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret alerting systems send in the X-Webhook-Secret header. Returned only when minted, so it is preserved in state across updates.
- `webhook_url` (String) Inbox URL alerting systems POST to; set only for webhook:incoming responders.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Oncall responders are imported with the owning org ID and the responder ID.
# The JSON-encoded groups (triggers, tools, ...) are config-authoritative and
# are not recovered by import; the first plan after import restates them. The
# webhook_secret of an imported webhook responder stays empty: the API only
# returns it when it is minted.
terraform import devin_oncall_responder.payments org-e2a868a8a12a4c53809dea41fbf7ee99/auto-24364480e58149da814b3aa2b3d0aa31
```
